title: Wii Fit Plus Complete W/ Manual - Nintendo Wii
descriptionText:
Get in shape with Wii Fit Plus Complete for Nintendo Wii. This fitness and health game offers a fun and interactive way to exercise. The game includes a manual and is rated E-Everyone, making it suitable for all ages. 

Released in 2009, this game is compatible with NTSC-U/C (US/Canada) region codes and is published by Nintendo. The platform is Nintendo Wii and the genre is fitness and health. The game is not a custom bundle and is made in an unknown country/region of manufacture. Get fit with Wii Fit Plus Complete and enjoy a healthy lifestyle.
